OnlyRecipe - Your Personal Recipe Collection

Save. Organise. Cook. Print. OnlyRecipe is the perfect companion for food lovers who want to build their ultimate recipe collection. Whether you're discovering new recipes online or saving family favorites, OnlyRecipe makes it easy to keep all your recipes in one beautiful, organized place.

Why Choose OnlyRecipe?

Simple & Beautiful
• Clean, intuitive interface designed for cooking
• Save recipes from any website with one tap
• Beautiful recipe cards that make browsing a joy

Smart Storage
• Free tier: Save up to 20 recipes locally on your device
• Premium: Unlimited recipes with secure cloud sync across all your devices
• Never lose your favorite recipes again

Premium Features
• Import Videos - Import recipes from social media videos
• Print Recipes - Print your recipes in beautiful, formatted pages
• In-App Browser - Browse and save recipes without leaving the app
• Unlimited Storage - Save as many recipes as you want
• Cloud Backup - Your recipes sync automatically across devices
• Ad-Free Experience - Cook without interruptions

Get Started Free

Start using OnlyRecipe completely free! Save up to 10 recipes on your device with no account required. When you're ready for more, upgrade to Premium for unlimited recipes and powerful features.

Try Premium Free for 7 Days

Experience all Premium features with our 7-day free trial:
• Save unlimited recipes
• Print your recipes
• Cloud sync across devices
• In-app browser
• Ad-free experience

No commitment required. Cancel anytime during the trial with no charges.

Choose the plan that works best for you. Both plans include all Premium features with automatic renewal. Cancel anytime through App Store settings.

Key Features

For Everyone:
• Save recipes from any website
• Organize your recipe collection
• Beautiful recipe cards with images
• Easy recipe browsing
• Free tier with 20 recipes

Premium Features:
• Unlimited recipe storage
• Cloud sync and backup
• Print recipes to PDF

• Cross-device synchronization
• Priority support

Your Privacy Matters

• Recipes stored securely with encryption
• Free tier: Recipes stored locally on your device
• Premium: Secure cloud sync with industry-standard encryption
• We never sell your data
• Your recipes are yours alone

Perfect For

• Home cooks building their recipe collection
• Food bloggers saving inspiration
• Families preserving recipes
• Anyone who loves to coo

quotes.text:
It can get frustrating skimming through text walls just to find the recipe on blogs/sites. Authors do it to get high ranking on Google.
You can use OnlyRecipe.app to extract the recipe information. It works on almost all sites/blogs which follow a recipe standard when they post.

You can also save it to your phone directly using the app. Scan recipe QR code using your phone camera and voila.

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mysticpeaks.onlyrecipe

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1602130759

Short 50-seconds video on how recipe camera scanner works 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ziSNwjv9PXo

Currently working on a feature that lets you share recipe "image cards" with your friends.. Something like this https://i.redd.it/kk1goqsswo981.png

Let me know if you'd use that feature
quotes.story_title: Show HN: OnlyRecipe.app – Remove clutter from recipe sites

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I posted the first version of OnlyRecipe here about four years ago [1], and the response was incredible. The feedback in that thread shaped a lot of what I wanted to build next. That initial momentum proved that the core problem (ads, life stories, and clutter on recipe blogs) needed a solution.

Progress since then has been slower than I hoped — I had some health issues and was building on and off — but I kept coming back to this project because I genuinely love working on it. I’ve been working on the project on and off, fitting development in whenever I could. This post represents a huge personal milestone.

Here’s what’s new after all this time:

Import from Videos: Import directly from TikTok, Instagram, Youtube and Facebook videos

Import from Handwritten recipes: Import from handwritten notes and screenshots

Unit Conversion: A highly-requested feature. Instantly convert US Customary (cups/oz) to Metric (grams/ml) for any extracted recipe.

Grocery Lists: Consolidate ingredients from multiple saved recipes into a single, clean shopping list.

Meal Plan: Plan your weekly meals in advance

Controls: Full recipe editing, PDF export, printing, and cross-device sync

Mobile-First Design: While the web view (linked above) is great for quickly seeing the result, the mobile apps have dedicated native controls for cooking mode (e.g., screen stay-awake, timers, and offline access).

In-App Browser: Directly import from any site within the app and many more...

To see …
